notes.title: 🟢Steam Next Fest Stream
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are participating in the Steam Next Fest and we will stream a pre-recorded gameplay video 
of our demo to give you a sneak peek into the world of The Witch in The Woods.

We will stream the gameplay in English and Chinese, so you might see the stream in Chinese if you drop in during that time. But we do have an English version.

Wishlist if you like it! :)

We look forward to seeing you at the fest! 


[previewyoutube=tvOYVMXOmdk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Witch In The Woods Demo Release
notes.content:
We have just released the demo for you to try! 

The demo is the content of the short prologue and the first chapter. It's only about 10% to 15% of the full game's content. 

We hope you enjoy it! :)
